models.convention: width along X, up +Y, the fin side toward +Z; origin = bottom centre of the back (mounting) face (z = 0 at the back)
models.texturePolicy: Meshy maps kept, Lanczos downsize + JPEG: base 1024 px q85, metallic-roughness 512 px q85, normal 1024 px q90; metallic-roughness and normal channel for channel; base colour graded by tools/asset-pipeline/props/lib/armor-palette.mjs (train-armor-palette-20261113 v1, task studio-train-armor-palette-20261113-213306-01): a deterministic per-texel OKLab grade of Meshy's own map — texels whose chroma (its 9x9 box mean at 2048 px) is below the map's own 0.62 chroma quantile become weathered steel (the map's median lightness and mean hue moved onto the car body's own light steel, 0.35 of the texel's own colour variation kept), those above its 0.94 quantile stay rust (chroma x0.9, 0.35 of the steel's lightness lift), a smooth blend between; hazard paint (chroma over 0.11) kept as generated; no generation, repaint or reprojection
